content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Presets stripe

Conventional platforms like Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle offer managed services that handle [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-first-principles-definitive-3|USDT Payment]]-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-works-how|payment]]s, product delivery, and customer management. They are easy to set up but come with significant tradeoffs: geographic restrictions, account suspensions, and lack of ownership over your data and infrastructure. Sovereign commerce stacks, in contrast, use open tools like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and NOWPayments to give creators full control. You own the hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. No platform can suspend your account or restrict your access based on location.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving 149 without access. PayPal suspends accounts in regions like Nigeria and Pakistan, often holding funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy follow similar restrictions, locking out creators in high-potential markets. Sovereign stacks bypass these limitations by leveraging globally accessible tools. Cloudflare Pages and Supabase work everywhere, and NOWPayments processes [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-which-architecture-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments without KYC or geographic barriers. The infrastructure is yours, so no platform can exclude you.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but their fees are secondary to the cost of exclusion. A suspended account or restricted region means zero revenue. Sovereign stacks use NOWPayments, which charges a flat 0.5% fee for crypto transactions. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain instantly, and the webhook triggers automatic product delivery. The real cost is the one-time deployment fee for your stack, after which you own everything.
Stripe excludes 149 countries, but sovereign infrastructure works everywhere.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms rent you access to their infrastructure. You depend on them for everything, from payment processing to product delivery. Sovereign stacks give you ownership of the entire process. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic, Supabase stores order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers files. Automation is built into the stack: payment confirmation triggers instant delivery, and you control every step. No platform can shut you down or change the rules on you.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you're in a Stripe-excluded country or face PayPal suspensions, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. For those who prefer to build their own, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides full documentation and source code. Choose based on your technical comfort and the urgency of your situation. Either way, you regain control and eliminate platform dependency.
